learn.title: Kingdom School
learn.coreCurriculumSubtitle: P2P Nhyehyɛe Titire yɛ Peer to Peer Global Discipleship Network asuafoɔyɛ akwantuo titire — wɔnam mpaebɔ so na wɔyɛe wɔ Honhom Kronkron akwankyerɛ ase, na egyina Kyerɛwsɛm tumi mu pintinn. Ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɛbɛma agyidifoɔ agyina pintinn wɔ Kristo mu, ayɛ wɔn honhom mu nyin, na apagyaw asuafoɔyɛfoɔ a wɔde Ahenniɛ nkɛntɛnso bɛkɔ ɔmanfoɔ tebea biara mu.
learn.coreCurriculumSubtitleQuote: Wɔato ne fapem wɔ Onyankopɔn Asɛm so. Honhom Kronkron na ɔkyerɛ kwan. Wɔasi ama asuafoɔyɛ.
learn.plansSubtitle: P2P Adesua Nhyehyɛe biara gyina Onyankopɔn Asɛm tumi mu, na wɔnam mpaebɔ so yɛe sɛ ɛbɛboa agyidifoɔ ama wɔanya asuafoɔyɛ a Kristo da mfimfini. Nokwafoɔ asɔre mpanyimfoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, nhyɛhofoɔ, ne Kristofoɔ akannifoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkanyan wɔn no nti, nhyehyɛe biara sesa Kyerɛwsɛm mu nokware ma ɛyɛ adesua akwantuo foforɔ a ɛhyɛ honhom mu nyin, ɔbra mu setie, ne Ahenniɛ nkɛntɛnso nkuran.
learn.plansSubtitleQuote: Nokwafoɔ nne na ɛkanyan. Ɛgyina Onyankopɔn Asɛm mu. Wɔayɛ sɛ ɛbɛma asuafoɔyɛ atrɛw.
